name: CENNETIC M4 Heavy-Duty Vertical Machining Center
summary: The CENNETIC M4 is a heavy-duty vertical machining center built on a one-piece, 5-ton-class cast bed with wide-spaced guideways for rigid, vibration-free cutting. A BT40 spindle (up to 12,000 rpm), a 24-tool disc magazine and 670 × 430 × 520 mm travel make it well suited to mold bases, steel parts and multi-operation machining.
body:
The CENNETIC M4 is a heavy-duty vertical machining center built on a one-piece, 5-ton-class cast bed with wide-spaced guideways for rigid, vibration-free cutting. A BT40 spindle (up to 12,000 rpm), a 24-tool disc magazine and 670 × 430 × 520 mm travel make it well suited to mold bases, steel parts and multi-operation machining.

Equipment

Standard equipment

  • Bed — Cast iron — resin-sand casting (HT250)
  • Bed — Ball screw — HIWIN (Taiwan) C3 Ø40×12
  • Bed — Linear guideway — INA (Germany) roller RG45 (X/Y/Z)
  • Appearance — Sheet-metal enclosure — full enclosure (ivory + dark grey)
  • Lubrication — RGB electric oiler
  • Lighting — LED linear work lamp
  • Service — Freight — out-of-province
  • Service — Dedicated transport
  • Service — Warranty — 2 years
  • Service — Training — on-site

Optional equipment

  • Spindle — Suge (Taiwan) mechanical spindle (BT40, 12,000 rpm)
  • Electrical — Feed motor — Syntec / Mitsubishi servo (Z braked)
  • Electrical — Spindle motor — Syntec / Mitsubishi (7.5–11 kW)
  • System — CNC — Syntec 22MA / Mitsubishi M80A
  • Tool Change — OKADA (Taiwan) disc-type magazine (BT40, 24 tools)
  • Chip Conveyor — ChienKuan scraper-type

About this model

This Vertical Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
